description: Amcor plc is the global leader in developing and producing responsible primary packaging solutions across a variety of materials for nutrition, health, beauty and wellness categories. Its global product innovation and sustainability expertise produces a range of flexible packaging, rigid packaging, cartons and closures that are more sustainable, functional and appealing, and in fiscal year 2026 approximately 75,000 Amcor people generated $23.5 billion in annual sales from operations spanning approximately 400 locations in more than 40 countries. It completed its merger with Berry Global Group, Inc. on April 30, 2025, and in May 2026 its Board of Directors approved a change in fiscal year end from June 30 to December 31.
